title: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples — Strings
author: Lawrence Fritts and the University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios
credit: Stereo ff violin, viola, cello and double bass recordings, arco and pizzicato. Honeydew selects, retunes, resamples and loops/shortens recordings; no endorsement is implied.
notes: Official unrestricted-use grant retained in LICENSE.txt. Individual stereo AIFF recordings linked from the 2012 string pages, downloaded 2026-10-14; recordings are 44.1 kHz. Source filenames are preserved in originals/, converted losslessly to wav/<same stem>.wav using ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -i INPUT.aif -map_metadata -1 -c:a pcm_s24le OUTPUT.wav. Bowed and plucked programs are single ff layers sampled every three semitones. Per-zone tune corrects measured source intonation. High pizzicato notes with unstable/incorrect pitches are omitted: violin above E5, viola above A5, cello above A4, bass above G3; adjacent zones cover their keyboard range. Bowed violin omits Db7 and E7 because their short takes lack useful sustains; the Bb6 zone covers higher notes.

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/GregSullivan.E-Pianos. Honeydew adaptations: neutral preset names, DW Sampler mapping, resampling and 16-bit FLAC encoding, gain normalization, trimmed decays and note-off envelopes; upstream release samples, per-region gain/start/end controls and ARIA controls are not reproduced.
